newsitem.title: USA: Global Intellicom to ship IBM voice tools.
newsitem.headline: Global Intellicom to ship IBM voice tools.

text.p: Global Intellicom Inc said Tuesday its Speech Solution unit has agreed to start shipping Voice Tools ActiveX custom controls for IBM Corp's VoiceType Dictation System version 3.0 speech recognition products on Thursday.
Speech Solutions said its tools enable programmers working with Visual Basic to incorporate voice functionality into software programs.

The complete package includes Speech Solutions Voice Tools software, the special developers runtime version of IBM VoiceType Dictation System for Windows, a noise canceling microphone, full documentation, and sample applications. The company said the voice tools package will retail for an introductory price of $299 through June 1.
Speech Solutions has been developing software for the IBM VoiceType Speech Recognition since 1993, the company said.
